author: hand_authored_by_PI
purpose: Calibration task for monthly recurring financial report.
request_text: Generate the monthly revenue summary for the executive team for the prior calendar month. Required content: gross revenue by product line; month-over-month percentage change for each product line; list of all deals exceeding $100,000 in value with their revenue recognition status (recognized, deferred, or pending). Data sources: Salesforce CRM for deal data, and our finance system of record for recognition status. Format: PDF document, 3 to 5 pages. Deadline: first business day of the following month, 1000 hours. Restrict to data from authorized regions only: United States, Canada, United Kingdom. Distribution: executive team only.

expected_anchor.mission_intent: Provide executive team with monthly revenue summary showing product performance and major deal status

minimum.threshold: gross revenue by product, MoM change, deals over $100K
first business day of following month at 1000

notes_for_lead_analyst: Tests multi-source data binding and regional constraint extraction.
